title: Frozen source questions for fictional tool-library architecture
purpose: Independent source-meaning and review-answer checks. IDs, counts, package shapes and renderer implementation are deliberately not prescribed.

questions.question: What is inside the service, what authority stays external, and what has not been designed?
expectedEvidence: A service boundary that includes volunteer handling and coordination
An external registry eligibility exchange
An external repair outcome exchange
Logical responsibility choices marked as proposals
forbiddenClaims: The service decides membership eligibility
A cloud application or automated locker has been selected
Repair methods or home delivery are designed

questions.question: Can eligibility and condition be assessed independently, and must the correct two results be reconciled before a ready reservation?
expectedEvidence: Concurrent registry request and candidate inspection
A ready condition requiring eligible member AND fit identified tool
Member decision and tool inspection identities preserved in the exchanges
forbiddenClaims: Eligibility substitutes for condition assessment
A fit tool substitutes for eligibility
The source requires a fixed eligibility-then-inspection sequence
An unavailable result is treated as eligible

questions.question: How do the no-candidate, ineligible, unavailable and unfit cases differ?
expectedEvidence: No candidate offers wait-list or member-selected closure without allocating inventory
Ineligible remains an accountable refusal/clarification case
Registry unavailable remains pending
Unfit candidate is quarantined and candidate selection can repeat
forbiddenClaims: Every failure follows the same successful checkout path
A wait-list is a tool reservation
The source supplies a registry timeout or fairness algorithm

questions.question: What starts the hold clock, what is its minimum, and when does that obligation cease to apply?
expectedEvidence: A duration requirement of at least 2 h on the ready-reservation hold
The clock origin is confirmed notice delivery
Member withdrawal and new fault are explicit exceptions
Coordinator extension with reason is distinguishable from expiration
forbiddenClaims: Queuing or sending a notice proves delivery
A reservation expires two hours after the request
The minimum fixes a universal exact two-hour hold
Two hours proves storage or volunteer capacity

questions.question: What happens when a notice lacks confirmation?
expectedEvidence: Pending-notification state or explicit equivalent
Contact exception assigned to the coordinator
No inferred delivered timestamp or expiry from unconfirmed delivery
forbiddenClaims: A missing delivery acknowledgement starts the ordinary expiry clock
An acknowledgement technology or maximum retry time is source-mandated

questions.question: What event and evidence transfer custody at collection and return?
expectedEvidence: Matched member, reservation and tool plus member acceptance before on-loan custody
Steward-confirmed receipt before returned library custody
Unresolved match/acceptance retained under coordinator ownership
forbiddenClaims: Ready status completes the loan
Member reports of return prove library receipt
Every item handover is represented only by a traceability citation

questions.question: Can a repair report by itself return a tool to available inventory?
expectedEvidence: Repair report flows to steward reassessment
Fit reassessment permits coordinator quarantine release
Unresolved defects keep quarantine and lead to a new repair or retirement decision
forbiddenClaims: The repair provider controls availability
Technical work completion automatically releases quarantine
Every returned tool is immediately available

questions.question: Does the inventory state preserve exclusivity through reservation, custody and condition changes?
expectedEvidence: Identified tool status distinguishes available, reserved, on loan, awaiting assessment and quarantined
Availability is prohibited while any incompatible condition holds
State changes have responsible decisions or evidence
forbiddenClaims: A tool can be available and on loan in the same selected case
An event label without conditions establishes availability
The state model proves concurrency implementation correct

questions.question: What does the logical decomposition allocate, and can a reviewer follow one complete behavioural slice?
expectedEvidence: A connected request-to-loan or return-to-availability scenario with typed information/object/control exchanges
Function-to-logical responsibility allocation distinct from human operational participation
Requirements and planned verification tied to the relevant subject
forbiddenClaims: A list of paragraph definitions alone is complete architecture
An actor dependency alone is functional allocation
A selected logical decomposition is source-approved

questions.question: How would the source obligations be checked, and which results remain unknown?
expectedEvidence: Planned checks of both conjunctive readiness inputs and each non-success outcome
Planned hold check before 2 h and at/after the chosen deadline, referenced to confirmed delivery and exceptions
Planned repair-complete-but-still-unfit case
Unknown demand, capacity, timing, fairness and freshness inputs remain explicit decisions/data needs
forbiddenClaims: A parser pass establishes verified operations
Service throughput is calculated without demand or capacity inputs
A verification plan is an executed result
All unresolved source decisions are automatically accepted
